<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<rules lang="en">
<category id="CAT" name="Category">
<rule id="PREFIXFORCONSISTENCYRULES_SPELL_UK" name="n"><pattern><token>colour</token></pattern><message>m PREFIXFORCONSISTENCYRULES_SPELL_UK</message><example correction="">a <marker>colour</marker></example></rule>
<rule id="PREFIXFORCONSISTENCYRULES_SPELL_US" name="n"><pattern><token>color</token></pattern><message>m PREFIXFORCONSISTENCYRULES_SPELL_US</message><example correction="">a <marker>color</marker></example></rule>
<rule id="PREFIXFORCONSISTENCYRULES_SPELL_CA" name="n"><pattern><token>colur</token></pattern><message>m PREFIXFORCONSISTENCYRULES_SPELL_CA</message><example correction="">a <marker>colur</marker></example></rule>
<rule id="PREFIXFORCONSISTENCYRULES_DATE_ISO" name="n"><pattern><token>iso</token></pattern><message>m PREFIXFORCONSISTENCYRULES_DATE_ISO</message><example correction="">a <marker>iso</marker></example></rule>
<rule id="PREFIXFORCONSISTENCYRULES_DATE_US" name="n"><pattern><token>usd</token></pattern><message>m PREFIXFORCONSISTENCYRULES_DATE_US</message><example correction="">a <marker>usd</marker></example></rule>
</category>
</rules>
